description: Developer guides for @n3wth/ui, Kit's component registry, agent Skills, and r3 memory: installation, working examples, configuration, and troubleshooting.
rules: Choose UI for an installed React design-system dependency and Kit for component source copied into the consuming project; their installation and update contracts differ.
Use @n3wth/ui/site for shared site compositions, @n3wth/ui/primitives for native controls, and one documented foundation stylesheet. Applications do not import Astryx directly.
Use Node 24 and npm 11.19.1 for monorepo development, install at the root, and build shared packages before consumers with root build commands.
The r3 website lives in apps/r3-web; its core runtime, Redis tests, and package release workflow remain in the separate n3wth/r3 repository.
Read and review skill instructions before installing them. Use the installation path documented for the chosen client; do not assume every client uses the same skill discovery format.
Verify commands, exports, and configuration against the relevant product guide. Keep credentials out of examples, client repositories, and documentation.
